summary: SiteDocument represents a document associated with a particular site, used in HSPnet. It is a simple data structure containing identifiers for both the document and the site.
purpose: To model and store site-related documents, enabling identification and association of documents to specific sites.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web user interface component for staff administrators. It displays welcome information, last login time, and provides access to site and discipline drop-downs for filtering and viewing employment applications. It uses various validators for form fields and allows searching and paginating submitted employment applications.
purpose: To provide staff administrators a dashboard for viewing and managing employment applications with quick access to site and discipline filters, showing application statuses, and handling user messages and errors.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select site and discipline from dropdowns
Set date range using calendar controls
Choose whether to show withdrawn applications
Click Refresh to view results
Employment applications grid displays data
Click name to open application details

business_rules: Start date must be before end date
Email addresses are displayed only if present
Status and withdrawn date are shown based on application state
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end dates
CustomValidator to check start date precedes end date
conditions: If no last login, hide panel
If application is withdrawn, show Withdrawn status and withdrawn date
system_behavior: Auto-populates dropdowns for sites and disciplines
exceptions: If UserSession is null, cancel data select
If invalid date input, show validation errors
content_gaps: No details on data persistence or error handling logic beyond UI validation

summary: ServiceCode is a data model that represents a service code with properties including ID, category, name, short name, notes, and alternate descriptions. ServiceCodes provides methods to retrieve lists of service codes from the database via stored procedures, optionally supporting alternate language fields.
purpose: To manage and retrieve service codes and their metadata for use in application workflows like course and timetable assignments.

workflows.name: Retrieve All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session
Stored procedure queries codes
Results are populated as a list

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes by Course or Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID
Stored procedure queries with parameters
Populate results list

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alternate descriptions and notes
system_behavior: Retrieves codes using SQL stored procedures
Populates lists for UI or workflow consumption
content_gaps: No detailed description of error handling or persistence

summary: SiteProfileHistory captures audit and change history data for site profiles, including action date, user details, changed fields, agency information, and formatted descriptions. The data object is used to retrieve, store, and display histories of site profile modifications.
purpose: To track and display historical changes made to site profiles for audit and accountability.

workflows.name: View Site Profile History
steps: Initiate history search with SiteID and SessionAgencyID
Retrieve history entries via stored procedure
Display history grid with formatted details

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is enabled, use alternate screen section and action fields
calculations: ActionDateFormatted: Formats action date for display
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted: Formats details using name and phone
conditions: If user is sysadmin or acting user differs from original, append support team label
content_gaps: No specifics on user identification for auditing
No details on the persistence or security of historical records

summary: EmailPopupDocument models a file attachment for email popups, including file name, path, and checked state. EmailPopupDocuments provides methods for searching and deleting email attachments, handling file and directory deletion logic on the backend.
purpose: To allow management of email popup attachments, enabling searching for existing files and deleting them as needed.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Identifier for the email popup document

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Call Search with DataInfo
Parse and split data into list of documents

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Call Delete with DataInfo and ID
Locate file using DataInfo and ID
Delete file and containing folder
Reconstruct DataInfo minus deleted entry

business_rules: Only delete if both file and folder exist
conditions: If DataInfo is empty, skip processing
content_gaps: No user interaction or security details
No handling for file lock or concurrent deletion
